decks.notes: The deck focuses on utilizing the companion Jegantha, the Wellspring to enable a 5-color aggressive strategy. By running a mix of multi-colored lands and spells, the deck aims to quickly overwhelm opponents with efficient creatures like Wild Nacatl, Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, and Scion of Draco. Tribal Flames serves as a versatile removal option, while Leyline Binding and Stubborn Denial provide protection for your board. Dromoka's Command offers additional utility, further solidifying the deck's aggressive game plan.

The main concept of this deck is to cycle through your deck quickly using cards like Street Wraith and Architects of Will to get your combo pieces in the graveyard. Once you have enough creatures in the graveyard, you can cast Living End to bring them all back onto the battlefield at once, overwhelming your opponent with a powerful board presence. The deck also includes counterspells like Force of Negation to protect your combo, as well as creatures like Shardless Agent and Curator of Mysteries to help dig for your combo pieces.

This control deck focuses on utilizing powerful control elements such as Counterspell, Teferi, Time Raveler, and Leyline Binding to disrupt opponents and maintain board control. The inclusion of cards like Solitude and Supreme Verdict provide additional removal options, while Omnath, Locus of Creation offers a strong win condition. The deck is supported by a diverse mana base that includes fetch lands and dual lands, allowing for consistent mana fixing and access to all colors needed for the deck's spells. The companion, Kaheera, the Orphanguard, provides additional support and synergy with the deck's creatures.

This UR Aggro deck focuses on quickly applying pressure with efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent, while disrupting the opponent's game plan with counter spells like Spell Snare and Counterspell. The deck also utilizes cantrips like Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration to filter through the deck and find the necessary cards to maintain tempo and win the game. The inclusion of removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat helps clear the way for attacks and protect your own creatures. The land base is optimized for consistency and speed, with fetch lands like Polluted Delta and Scalding Tarn helping to fix mana and thin out the deck.

The main idea of the deck is to quickly and aggressively control the board with a combination of fast, efficient spells and powerful creatures. By utilizing strong tempo plays like Lightning Bolt and Counterspell, along with creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent, the deck aims to pressure the opponent while disrupting their game plan. The inclusion of cards like Spell Pierce and Fiery Islet further enhances the deck's ability to control the pace of the game and maintain a strong board presence.

The main idea behind this deck is to quickly deal damage to the opponent using efficiently costed burn spells and aggressive creatures. The deck focuses on putting pressure on the opponent early in the game, while also disrupting their ability to gain life. By efficiently utilizing burn spells like Lava Spike, Lightning Bolt, and Boros Charm alongside creatures like Goblin Guide and Monastery Swiftspear, the deck is able to effectively close out games before the opponent has a chance to stabilize. This deck aims to win quickly and decisively through aggressive play and direct damage.

This deck focuses on utilizing Indomitable Creativity to cheat out powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Leyline Binding quickly. The deck also includes various lands and spells to manipulate the board state and protect its combo pieces. The combination of card advantage from Teferi, Time Raveler and removal spells like Prismatic Ending and Lightning Bolt help control the game until the combo can be assembled. The key strategy is to disrupt the opponent's game plan while setting up a game-winning combo in a creative way.

The key concept of this deck is to control the game through a combination of powerful control spells and efficient creatures. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy with cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Leyline Binding while also presenting threats like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines. This deck utilizes a variety of lands to ensure it can cast its spells consistently and efficiently, making it a versatile and adaptable control deck in the Modern 1 vs 1 format.

This deck focuses on aggressive play by utilizing creatures with disruptive abilities like Leonin Arbiter and Thalia, Guardian of Thraben to slow down opponents. The deck also uses blink effects to flicker powerful creatures like Skyclave Apparition and Archon of Emeria to gain additional value. Aether Vial allows for cheating creatures into play at instant speed, while equipment like Sword of Fire and Ice and Kaldra Compleat provide additional combat benefits. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggression and disruptive tactics.

The deck focuses on utilizing powerful control elements such as Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six to disrupt the opponent's game plan while generating incremental advantage. It also includes powerful threats like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines to quickly close out the game. The deck aims to control the board with removal spells like Prismatic Ending and Solitude while using Leyline Binding to lock down key permanents. The inclusion of cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and The One Ring provide additional win conditions and card advantage.

The main focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive Merfolk tribal strategy. Utilizing lords like Lord of Atlantis and Master of the Pearl Trident to boost the power of Merfolk creatures, along with disruptive cards like Merfolk Trickster and Tide Shaper to control the board. The deck also includes counter spells like Force of Negation for protection. The synergy between Merfolk creatures and powerful tribal support cards allows for strong board presence and quick wins, making it a formidable Aggro deck in the Modern format.

This deck focuses on using the UrzaTron lands to assemble a powerful mana base, allowing for the early deployment of threats like Karn, the Great Creator and Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger. It also includes various utility cards like Relic of Progenitus and Oblivion Stone to control the game and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The inclusion of a companion like Jegantha, the Wellspring adds an extra layer of consistency and flexibility to the deck. Overall, the key concept revolves around leveraging powerful cards and mana acceleration to dominate the game.

This deck focuses on quickly gaining control of the board with aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent, while also disrupting the opponent with spells like Counterspell and Unholy Heat. The deck aims to maintain tempo and pressure through a combination of efficient threats and versatile interaction, utilizing cards like Expressive Iteration and Consider to dig through the deck and find the right answers. With a mix of burn, counter spells, and evasive threats, it seeks to quickly close out games before the opponent can stabilize.
